Align development tooling and Node.js checks

Fail CI and publishing installations when dependencies require a newer Node.js version than the workflow provides. Use ci.yml with the CI workflow name, multiline YAML lists, consistent job and step names, and read-only repository permissions.

Declare the CommonJS package type and lint .mjs files with Node.js globals that exclude CommonJS-only bindings. Align ESLint configuration structure, npm script ordering, and Git ignore patterns with the other jsdom projects.

Update ESLint config to 6.1.0 and the jsdom development dependency to 30.1.3, and regenerate the lockfile.
